title: [ingest] SPHINX_AUTODOC_RELOAD_MODULES env var triggers TYPE_CHECKING reload pass
summary: When `SPHINX_AUTODOC_RELOAD_MODULES=1` is set, `import_module()` in `sphinx.ext.autodoc.importer` reloads all newly imported modules a second time with `typing.TYPE_CHECKING = True`, so annotations guarded by `TYPE_CHECKING` are resolved. This is a workaround for packages that use `if TYPE_CHECKING:` imports for type hints.
